environment: dedicated Linux Xvfb :96; software OpenGL; isolated game directory; no account credentials

colorCases.gold: regular mixed widths and non-breaking-space/unsupported-code-point cases

clock: System.nanoTime immediately before/after each Robot screen sample; milliseconds relative to sampling start
limits: Screen polling can miss rendered frames or sample near a swap. These transitions are not native render timestamps.
A random replacement may repeat. This does not establish a universal FPS or exact random sequence.
The default client glyph pool is broader than the independent bundled OFL font. No complete animated-raster parity claim.
Raw cropped PNGs and client resources remain local; this manifest publishes numerical evidence and hashes only.
